_comment: platt_file        : Path to a Q-POP-FerroDyn-Kokkos P_Lattice_*.h5 or PLatt_*.h5 file.
The code auto-detects the dataset prefix (P_Lattice_x/y/z or PLatt_x/y/z).
displacement_file : Path to a Displacement_*.h5 file.  Set to null to use zero displacements.
x_limits          : [start, end]  0-indexed, inclusive, along x.  Omit or null → full axis.
phase_file        : Optional HDF5 of phase fractions phase_1 .. phase_<nPhase>, shaped like the fields.
null → one phase per Is_FE material, from materialField.
region_file       : Optional HDF5 with a scattering weight 'region', shaped like the fields.  null → 1.
output_file       : Base name for output files (no extension).
Open {output_file}.xdmf in ParaView for 3-D q-space visualisation.
